name: kr-big-roboport-vanilla-size
title: K2 Big Roboport - Vanilla Size
author: deadrat22
description: Shrinks Krastorio 2's big roboport (and its logistic/construction mode variants) to the vanilla roboport footprint: 4x4 tiles instead of 8x8. Graphics, charging pads, stationing offset and circuit connector are scaled to match. All stats (charging energy, radii, robot slots, health) are unchanged. Without Krastorio 2 installed this mod does nothing.
